record: AUTHORITATIVE V1 REFERENCE NUMBERS — the values the B3 harness must land on

provenance.protocol_ablation: same + --curation off --m22-levers-off, REUSE store, NO --reindex, SCORED-ONLY corpora
provenance.scoring: offline set-match vs FROZEN gold, FIRST-occurrence-per-gold-identity, frozen denominators

tolerance.head_only_at_k: EXACT to 4 decimals — deterministic set-match; any drift is a real semantic change, not noise
tolerance.gold_at_budget_wire: EXACT to 4 decimals — read from the report's own token_coverage_wire
tolerance.reach_at_80: EXACT to 4 decimals; note 1 instance = 2.70pp (ts40) / 2.56pp (py), so a single-instance move is visible
tolerance.cross_run_reproduction: a DIFFERENT run of the same config may move within the pre-registered NOISE_FLOOR = 2.75pp (criteria.py:49); a harness REPLAYING these reports must be EXACT

harness_must_not: re-derive gold (score against the pinned frozen gold files above)
use full 40-instance corpora on a REUSE run (fall-through re-analyses the excluded instance; belt drift)
whole-file cmp a frozen gold (the header stamps the producing binary — compare payload + the 5 claim-bearing header fields)
credit a gold more than once (first-occurrence-per-gold-identity; ranked lists legitimately repeat identities)
claim superiority at py @10 (p=0.125, CI spans 0); @25 only (p=0.0078)
